page.overview:
What is Armadillo Bears?

Led by the fiery Ben Ta and her second-in-command, Rameh, the band was mostly nomadic, traveling to wherever people from the Earth Kingdom needed them the most during the Great War, but they used Xiadi as their home base,

These freedom fighters had their hearts in the right place and were willing to help people in need. They were secretive out of necessity but happy to trust those who earnestly wanted to help fight against the Fire Nation. The Armadillo Bears were not the most skilled fighters, but what they lacked in technique, they made up for in loyalty and sheer willpower. They fought becaused they had to, and refused to lose because that meant innocent people could be hurt.

When Ben Ta got word that General Onomu had been spotted nearby after she was due to be escorted to Ba Sing Se by a group of people working for the Earth Kingdom government, after the general planned to defect from the Fire Nation, she led the Armadillo Bears on a mission to hunt Onomu down and kill her, planning to track the party escorting her from West Heiatu to Ba Sing Se.
